about: G10 task table (tools/guards/task_dump.py) at dev_refactor cb9226e, bench variant. Each row is what the source makes the task run with: file:line of the config, sdkconfig values from the bench build (sdkconfig.defaults;ci/sdkconfig.bench), and the IDF rule that changes it where one does. Checked against the first board dump (C:/b/bench/results/guardsmerge-cb9226e-20261006-131950). Two IDF 6.0 rules apply to many rows: (1) espp::Task and std::thread run on IDF pthreads, and pthread_create takes priority 0 to mean 'use CONFIG_PTHREAD_TASK_PRIO_DEFAULT' (5) (components/pthread/pthread.c:336); (2) an unpinned task is pinned to the core it runs on at its first FPU or PIE use (FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/riscv/portasm.S:99), which differs from boot to boot (ContinuousAdc: core 1 on cb9226e, core 0 on a837c08), so those rows declare core "fpu" (any core, with coproc_pinned true; -1 before the first FPU use). Core -1 rows must stay unpinned. stack_bytes is the created size; the dump reads 0-15 B less (16 B alignment of the stack end, FreeRTOS-Kernel/tasks.c:1054-1064). No stack_free: CS-MEM-04 floors (stack_free_min) wait for the stress test.
